tables.name: posts
tables.custom_sql: CREATE POLICY anon_select ON posts FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated USING (true); CREATE POLICY owner_insert ON posts FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid()); CREATE POLICY owner_update ON posts FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (user_id = auth.uid()) WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid()); CREATE POLICY owner_delete ON posts FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (user_id = auth.uid());

notes: Anyone (anon + authenticated) can read all posts. Authenticated users can insert/update/delete only their own posts (user_id must match auth.uid()). Built-in templates can't express this combination, so it's a single 'custom' policy.
